name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: lead removals, reports owed, tests overdue, drug screens and follow-ups

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: The same list as /attention. The law first, then the practitioner's programme, then everything else.
sections.sql: select item, ref, detail from (select 1 as r, 'remove from lead work now' as item, worker_code as ref, worker || ': blood lead ' || blood_lead || ' ug/dL' as detail from v_lead where standing = 'remove now' union all select 1, 'regulator not sent', ref, worker || ' ' || test_code || ' ' || done_on from v_reports where standing = 'regulator not sent' union all select 2, case when basis = 'law' then 'test overdue (law)' else 'test overdue (programme)' end, worker_code, worker || ' ' || test_name || ' due ' || due_on from v_due where standing in ('overdue', 'baseline overdue') union all select 3, standing, ref, worker || ' ' || test_code || ' ' || done_on from v_reports where standing in ('report not obtained', 'worker not given copy') union all select 3, standing, ref, worker || ' ' || sample from v_dna where standing in ('non-negative not sent to lab', 'lab result overdue', 'employer not told')) x order by r, item, ref

sections.title: Due in the next 30 days
sections.sql: select worker, employer, grp as group_code, test_name as test, due_on, standing from v_due where standing in ('due soon', 'baseline due') order by due_on

sections.title: Follow-up actions open
sections.sql: select a.ref, w.name as worker, a.what, a.due_on, case when a.due_on < current_date then 'overdue' else 'open' end as standing from actions a join workers w on w.id = a.worker_id where a.done_on is null order by a.due_on

name: recall
title: Recall list
subtitle: Every test every worker needs, soonest first, with the rule that sets the date

sections.title: Not current
sections.sql: select employer, worker, grp as group_code, test_name as test, last_on, due_on, days_left, standing, rule from v_due where standing <> 'current' order by due_on, employer, worker

sections.title: By exposure group
sections.sql: select grp as group_code, employer, count(distinct worker_id)::int as workers, count(*) filter (where standing in ('overdue', 'baseline overdue'))::int as overdue, count(*) filter (where standing in ('due soon', 'baseline due'))::int as due_soon from v_due group by grp, employer order by overdue desc, grp

name: lead
title: Lead register
subtitle: Every worker in lead risk work: last blood lead against the removal and return levels

sections.title: Workers
sections.sql: select worker_code as code, worker, employer, blood_lead, last_on, removal_level, return_level, removal, standing from v_lead order by blood_lead desc nulls last

sections.title: Removals
sections.sql: select r.ref, w.name as worker, r.removed_on, r.reason, r.regulator_on, r.returned_on, r.cleared_by from removals r join workers w on w.id = r.worker_id order by r.removed_on desc

name: money
title: Money
subtitle: Done and not invoiced, and invoices not paid

sections.title: Done, not invoiced
sections.sql: select employer, currency, count(*)::int as items, sum(amount_cents)::bigint as amount_cents, min(day) as oldest from v_unbilled group by employer, currency order by employer

sections.title: Invoices not paid
sections.sql: select i.ref, e.code as employer, i.currency, i.total_cents, i.raised_on, i.due_on, i.sent_on, case when i.sent_on is null then 'not sent' when i.due_on < current_date then 'overdue' else 'sent' end as standing from invoices i join employers e on e.id = i.employer_id where i.paid_on is null order by i.due_on
